CustomField.description: Stable kebab-case or underscore slug for this template. Used by FQS_CampaignHierarchyBuilder to look up templates, resolve parent-child links, and persist to the audit CMDT. Must be unique across all FQS_Campaign_Template__mdt records and must not be changed after deployment (it is the programmatic identifier, not the DeveloperName).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A stable unique identifier for this template used by the Apex builder. Do not change this value after deployment — doing so will break parent-child links in the builder.
CustomField.label: Template Key
